item.title: Dropbox is an obvious PE Target?
item.description:
📝 I have been doing research on companies, reading 10-Ks, etc. Dropbox would not be a strategic acquisition since most of the major enterprise companies already have a solid storage business. From a Hamilton Hemler perspective, their main power is to allow for sustainable long-term cash flow, which would be switching costs.
🔗 Read more: https://s-1.vercel.app/posts/why-dropbox-is-a-obvious-pe-target/
